name: Ubuntu XFCE Workspace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y xfce4 xfce4-goodies tigervnc-standalone-server novnc websockify kid3-qt wget xz-utils dbus-x11 && wget -O tg.tar.xz https://telegram.org/dl/desktop/linux && tar -xf tg.tar.xz && sudo mv Telegram /opt/ && sudo ln -sf /opt/Telegram/Telegram /usr/local/bin/telegram-desktop && rm tg.tar.xz
postStartCommand: vncserver :1 -geometry 1280x720 -depth 24 -securitytypes None >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -f websockify || true; nohup websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc/ 6080 localhost:5901 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
